narrative: OMX30 enters Monday within a structural bull market (+8.5% above 200-MA) with strong directional conviction (ADX 56.1). European peers DAX and CAC led Friday with +1.32% and +1.06% respectively, setting positive momentum into Asian close and US sessions. However, technical overbought conditions (RSI 74.4, Stochastic K 84.8, Bollinger %B 1.00) present mean-reversion risk; the index sits 100% of 52-week range with zero buffer to cycle highs. Gold strength (+1.63%) and copper resilience (+1.62%) support mining/industrial sectors, while oil weakness (-6.57%) provides relief to consumer spending. Watch for profit-taking or rotation into value ahead of US Jobless Claims at 14:30 CET.
morningBrief: OMX30 opens with tailwinds from continental strength and commodity tailwinds, but overbought technicals demand tactical caution. DAX and CAC momentum (+1.32%, +1.06%) argues for a +0.4–0.8% open; however, RSI 74.4 and upper Bollinger breach (100% %B) signal mean reversion vulnerability. Support at 3085 (lower band) and 3123 (Monday close); resistance near 3180 (50-MA) and cycle highs. Sector strategy: long Banks (SEB A, Handelsbanken A) on widening NIM from yield stability; watch Boliden hard on gold/copper strength. Industrials (Atlas Copco, Volvo B) support stable EUR/SEK and USD/SEK. Avoid overweighting Tech (Ericsson B, Hexagon B) into NASDAQ flat territory and overbought ADX. Key watch: US Jobless Claims at 14:30 CET for risk sentiment reset. If OMX breaches 3180 decisively, expect squeeze higher; failure below 3120 could trigger 2–3% correction.
